Regarding the dialogue, the witness’s body language ("shifted uncomfortably") and the contrast between their past closeness and current distant, critical stance ("haven't seen him in years," "so has my opinion of him") suggest a relationship that has deteriorated significantly. The dynamic is one of estrangement and likely resentment or disappointment, indicating that the witness no longer holds the defendant in high regard despite their previous friendship.
